main.title: Shillong One Day Tour - Outskirts Itinerary

items: Your Shillong One Day Tour will begin by meeting our representative early in the morning, who will drive you around Shillong and lead you on this tour.

We will first take you to the Laitlum Canyons which translates to 'The End of the Hills'. Take in the charm of the vast landscapes and enjoy the fresh morning air at this destination. You can also engage in photography, capturing some amazing pictures at this beautiful spot.

After a refreshing visit to Laitlum Canyons, your next stop would be Mawphlang Sacred Forest. This mystical forest is preserved for centuries by Khasi tradition. This forest is an abode to various rare plant species and nothing could be taken away from here, not even a leaf as per traditional beliefs of the locals. Take a worthwhile walk to this forest and dive in the beauty of nature.

Our last stop would be the Khasi Heritage Village which is a recreated space that showcases the traditional Khasi culture, homes and lifestyles. You can witness some ancient tools, instruments and many such things there.
At the conclusion of your Shillong One Day Tour, our representative will drop you off at the location of your choice in Shillong.
Our team will do everything in our power to make your tour amazing and unforgettable.
